name: advisorworld-reference-data
description: Look up and compare sourced U.S. state income, estate, and inheritance tax reference data with field-level citations and verification receipts. Estimate state income tax when required inputs are substantiated, compare jurisdictions, and inspect dataset versions and coverage. Missing, uncited, unverified, pending-final, and not-applicable values remain distinct and are never silently treated as zero. All seven tools are read-only, require no account or API key, and provide reference information—not tax or legal advice.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Pinned U.S. state income, retirement-income, estate, inheritance tax, Medicaid-planning, and federal Roth transaction publications. Treat null, uncited, undated, pending-final, and not-applicable as distinct states; never convert them to zero. Retirement-income queries require one exact income type and never infer from a neighboring category. Roth transaction treatment is available for tax year 2026 only, separates federal taxability from Form 1099-R reporting, labels caller-provided inputs, preserves missing facts, verifies exact local TTA file and canonical digests, and never calculates final liability. Use get_reference_data_status for local dataset bindings, evidence age, and fail-closed future domains; evidence age is not proof that law remains current. Use dataset_info, retirement_income_dataset_info, estate_dataset_info, or medicaid_planning_dataset_info for dataset coverage and versions. compute_state_tax and analyze_state_tax_scenario cover state income tax only and run only when required rate inputs are substantiated. Scenario taxableIncome means caller-provided state taxable income after deductions and exclusions; planningContext is preserved as provenance but excluded from liability math. analyze_estate_tax_scenario computes only attorney-reviewed, primary-receipted schedules from exact caller-provided jurisdiction rate-table coordinates after applicable exclusions, deductions, exemptions, and excluded transfers; it never derives those coordinates from gross estate or gross inheritance, and unsupported credit, gifting, relationship, and deduction questions fail closed. Medicaid-planning tools are context-only, preserve every field status and source receipt unchanged, and fail closed when a requested evaluation date precedes publication or a cited fact's effective date. get_state_tax_history, get_state_retirement_income_history, and retirement-income treatments are context-only and never supply calculator inputs. Historical datasets are served only after

_published_faq.name: How do I add advisorworld-reference-data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add advisorworld-reference-data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.advisorworld.com/mcp.
